israel.text: Israel is one of America's closest allies. But this special alliance is far more than geopolitical, more than cultural – it's moral. Israel and the United States of America are built upon a shared foundation of Judeo-Christian values which, in turn, rest upon the very value of human life itself. Humanity's progress through the ages has been marked by recognition of this eternal truth.
